text:
deploy-bot: Canary paused: preflight health check failed for service api-gateway-canary. Reason=ConfigMap checksum mismatch (infra-values changed)

alex: saw the bot alert. which values changed?

maria: merged infra-values @10:42 after the chart push — ENABLE_NEW_CACHE flipped to true, changed the configmap hash. sorry, late merge.

jordan: that explains it. canary and control have different configmaps, so we get a mismatch. options: rollback chart, pin chart version, or patch canary configmap to match control.

release-manager: change window is still open for 40m. prefer pin + hotfix unless rollback is cleaner. what are risks?

sre-oncall: rollback will restore previous configmap but may cause brief pod churn. no DB migrations in this release, so rollback is low-risk. patching only canary is less disruptive.

alex: patching sounds good for minimal blast radius. example patch (will need manual approval):
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap api-cache --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/ENABLE_NEW_CACHE","value":"false"}]'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/api-gateway-canary
```

maria: I can push that patch in 2m. @release-manager please approve so I can apply. I'll also post the exact git commit that caused the late merge.

release-manager: approved. apply the patch and restart canary. add a short line to release notes about this values drift and who merged it.

deploy-bot: Reminder: automated rollback will trigger if canary stays unhealthy for >15m. rollback timer=0m.

jordan: after we confirm canary healthy, we'll pin chart_version=2.7.1 in infra-values lock for 24h to avoid re-triggering while downstream PRs land. I'll open the pin PR.

alex: drafting the release-note snippet now:
- Incident: canary pause due to configmap checksum mismatch (late infra-values merge)
- Mitigation: patched canary configmap and restarted canary
- Follow-up: temporarily pin chart to 2.7.1; revert late values merge in next scheduled deploy

sre-oncall: monitoring will watch 5xx and latency for 30m after restart. set alert if 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m.

maria: patch applied, restarted canary. health checks back to green :tada:

release-manager: thanks everyone. I'll publish a short note in #product and update the release notes doc. Keep the pin in place until tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Canary recovered, automated rollback timer cleared.
